description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cisco develops networking, security, operating system, firmware, and infrastructure technologies that connect and protect organizations. The Software Engineer Embedded Systems I will develop and maintain software and tools for hardware compatibility, network performance, and security across operating systems, firmware, and networking stacks. The role involves low-level programming, embedded Linux, networking protocols, hardware-software integration, automation, CI/CD, and DevSecOps practices.
Embedded software engineer developing operating systems, firmware, and networking stacks for secure hardware compatibility and performance

Responsibilities:
• Your work develops and maintains critical software and tools that ensure hardware compatibility, network performance, and security for Cisco’s core products like operating systems, firmware, and networking stacks
• By effectively managing your time and streamlining processes, you deliver high-quality solutions that embed resilience and efficiency into global communications infrastructure, directly contributing to Cisco’s leadership in trusted, scalable networking technologies

Requirements:
• A Bachelor's degree with **0 years of work experience**
• An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Associate's, Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) **with 1 year of work experience**
• High school diploma (or equivalent) **with 2 years of work experience.**
• Qualifying education and work experience should be in should be in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
• Proficiency in C programming and experience working in embedded Linux environments, including a solid understanding of operating system fundamentals
• Working knowledge of core networking principles, routing protocols, and general network architecture concepts
• Hands-on experience developing automation scripts (e.g., Python or Bash), utilizing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and applying DevSecOps practices within software workflows

Preferred:
• Conceptual understanding or hands-on experience with AI/ML
• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and security protocols
• Experience with FPGA development
• Knowledge of signal and power integrity, and PCB design
